name: PlexLibrarian
description: Library health insights for your Plex server. Find stale content, track viewing patterns, and review deletion destinations. Includes a Sign in with Plex setup wizard — or set PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN to skip OAuth entirely. Optional Sonarr/Radarr and qBittorrent deletion starts unchecked. For automatic discovery, install the optional Discovery helper and enable discovery once in Media connections. Fresh installations share the private transport volume automatically; no path entry is needed. Existing discovery installations must retain their original transport mount and pairing key. Discovery security release and complete native acceptance remain pending. The optional helper has host-administrator-equivalent Docker access; installing or updating it grants that image this authority. Plex sign-in does not restrict access to Librarian APIs; use a trusted administrator network. Discovery details provides saved-relationship diagnostics, backup and confirmed removal; existing qBittorrent path overrides remain read-only under Saved path mappings. Librarian has no Docker socket or ordinary-deletion media mounts. Selected media size is not a guarantee of disk space reclaimed.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Persistent app data directory for the database and saved settings. The default is ready to use.

paths.name: Library Inspection Path
paths.description: Optional local access for duplicate-version adoption only. Ordinary service-owned deletion needs no Librarian media mounts. Optional host discovery checks declared Docker mappings through the paired helper; inspect saved relationships in Discovery details. Local-access editors are not available in the single-host MVP.

paths.name: Download Inspection Path
paths.description: Optional Advanced local access for duplicate adoption checks only. Ordinary deletion uses current service records and configured service storage relationships; no Librarian download mount is required.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Plex Librarian web UI.

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Optional. URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:32400). Set this together with Plex Token to bypass the OAuth setup wizard.

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Optional. Your Plex authentication token. Set this together with Plex URL to bypass the OAuth setup wizard.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Full path inside the container where the SQLite database file lives. Only change this if you have a specific reason to.

variables.name: qBittorrent URL
variables.description: Optional power-user override. qBittorrent Web UI URL reachable from this container. Configure qBittorrent in the web UI instead for multiple instances.

variables.name: qBittorrent Username
variables.description: qBittorrent Web UI username. Leave blank only when authentication bypass trusts this container.

variables.name: qBittorrent Password
variables.description: qBittorrent Web UI password. Leave blank only when authentication bypass trusts this container.

variables.name: Library Sync Concurrency
variables.description: Max number of libraries synced in parallel. Kept low by default to avoid competing with Plex for resources on the same host — only raise this on dedicated hardware.

variables.name: Fetch Concurrency
variables.description: Max concurrent Plex page requests per library. Kept low by default to avoid competing with Plex for resources on the same host — only raise this on dedicated hardware.

variables.name: Sync Stall Timeout (minutes)
variables.description: Abort a sync if it reports no progress for this many minutes — e.g. the Plex server going offline mid-sync. Only raise this if you have a very slow or high-latency Plex connection triggering false positives.

variables.name: Log Retention (days)
variables.description: Days to keep sync history and activity feed entries before they're automatically deleted. Raise this to retain history longer, or set to 0 to keep them forever.
